note: Use the café's approved ingredients and quantities. These steps describe assembly only where the source menu did not provide a full recipe. Follow the customer's note when feasible and clarify any conflict before preparing.

hot-chocolate-fudge: Place the house two-flavour ice-cream combination in a 200 ml sundae serving.

brownie-fudge: Place the house two-flavour ice-cream combination in a 200 ml sundae serving.

build-your-own-sundae: Use the selected scoop count and the listed flavour for each scoop.
Place the scoops in the selected cup, waffle cone or waffle bowl.
Add the selected sauce and topping; include any requested extra sauce, extra topping and whipped cream.
english-cream-cheese: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Spread cream cheese and add cucumber, herbs and pepper.
Add extra cheese if selected; assemble and serve.
creamy-spinach-and-corn: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Add the house creamy spinach-and-sweet-corn filling and cheese.
Add extra cheese if selected; grill and serve hot.
grilled-paneer: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Add paneer, capsicum, lettuce and garlic dressing; include extra paneer or cheese if selected.
Grill the sandwich and serve hot.
english-scrambled-egg: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Cook the two-egg scrambled filling with cheese and black pepper; include the extra egg or cheese if selected.
Assemble the sandwich and serve hot.
grilled-chicken: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Add fully cooked chicken breast, lettuce, tomato and yogurt dressing; include extra chicken or cheese if selected.
Grill the sandwich and serve hot.
peanut-butter-banana: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Spread peanut butter and add banana and cinnamon.
blueberry-cheesecake-sandwich: Use whole-wheat bread if selected; otherwise use the house sandwich bread.
Spread cream cheese and blueberry fruit filling.
classic-veg-burger: Cook the ready-made veg patty according to its package directions and toast the bun.
Add burger mayonnaise, lettuce, onion and tomato.
Add one Amul cheese slice if selected; place the patty in the bun and serve hot.
classic-chicken-burger: Cook the ready-made chicken patty thoroughly according to its package directions and toast the bun.
Add burger mayonnaise, lettuce, onion and tomato.
Add one Amul cheese slice if selected; place the patty in the bun and serve hot.
salted-fries: Cook the fries until crisp using the café's standard method.
Drain, season with salt and serve hot.
peri-peri-fries: Cook the fries until crisp using the café's standard method.
Drain, toss with peri-peri seasoning and serve hot.
veg-steam-momos: Steam the veg momos until cooked through.
veg-fried-momos: Fry the veg momos until cooked through and crisp.
chicken-steam-momos: Steam the chicken momos thoroughly until cooked through.
chicken-fried-momos: Fry the chicken momos thoroughly until cooked through and crisp.
veg-nuggets: Cook the veg nuggets according to their package directions until hot throughout.
chicken-nuggets: Cook the chicken nuggets thoroughly according to their package directions.
veg-maggi: Prepare Maggi noodles with the house vegetable addition.
Mix with the cooked noodles and serve hot.
egg-maggi: Prepare Maggi noodles and cook the egg addition.
Mix the egg with the cooked noodles and serve hot.
chicken-maggi: Prepare Maggi noodles with fully cooked chicken.
Mix the chicken with the cooked noodles and serve hot.
virgin-mojito: Prepare the café's virgin mojito base and stir with ice.
Pour into the house serving glass and serve cold.
blue-curacao-mojito: Prepare the café's mojito base with Blue Curaçao flavour and ice.

optionInstructions.burger-cheese: If selected, add one Amul cheese slice to the burger.
optionInstructions.sandwich-cheese: If selected, include the extra cheese.
optionInstructions.sandwich-egg: If selected, cook and include the extra egg.
optionInstructions.sandwich-paneer: If selected, include the extra paneer.
optionInstructions.sandwich-chicken: If selected, include the extra fully cooked chicken.
optionInstructions.sundae-size: Use the selected number of scoops.
optionInstructions.sundae-flavors: Use the listed flavour for each scoop in order.
optionInstructions.sundae-serving: Use the selected cup, waffle cone or waffle bowl.
optionInstructions.sundae-sauce: Add the selected sauce; a second listed sauce is the paid extra.
optionInstructions.sundae-topping: Add the selected topping; a second listed topping is the paid extra.
optionInstructions.sundae-extras: Add only the extra sauce, topping or whipped cream selected on the order.
